# Constanza Gajardo León

> Journalism studies researcher. Postdoctoral Researcher at Vrije Universiteit Brussel, where she is scientific lead of the qualitative track of the ERC Starting Grant project INEQNEWS: Digital News Inequalities, and Assistant Professor at Universidad de Concepción, Chile. PhD, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (2023).

Her research brings citizens' perspectives into journalism studies: how audiences engage with news, why they remain loyal, what earns their trust, and how social and digital inequalities shape who feels served by journalism. She works mainly with qualitative and trace-based interview methods, in Latin America and Europe. She developed the Dynamic Model of Audience Engagement (Journalism, 2023).

## Consulting

Open to audience research consulting for newsrooms, journalism foundations, NGOs and public institutions, in Spanish and English, in Latin America and Europe: in-depth interviews and focus groups, trace-based interviews, local information needs assessments, workshops and training for journalists, audience strategy and evaluation, and research design.

## Selected publications

- Tabor, Kalogeropoulos, Rossini, Gajardo, Nicholls (2026). No time or tech for online news: How social and digital inequalities contribute to gender gaps in online news consumption. Journal of Information Technology & Politics. https://doi.org/10.1080/19331681.2026.2692137
- Gajardo, Kalogeropoulos, Rossini, Mont’Alverne, Nicholls (2026). Evaluating the potential and limits of trace-based interviews when studying news use. Information, Communication & Society. https://doi.org/10.1080/1369118X.2026.2652514
- Mellado, Gajardo (2026). The importance of the human touch in journalism: Journalistic values from an audience perspective. Journalism Practice. https://doi.org/10.1080/17512786.2024.2387668
- Mellado, Gajardo (2026). The impact of political ideology on news consumption: The mediating role of trust and the moderating role of interest in politics. Mass Communication and Society. https://doi.org/10.1080/15205436.2025.2546447
- Gajardo, Domingo, Costera Meijer (2025). Examining platforms’ affordances: Bridging journalists’ and users’ practices of online engagement. Digital Journalism. https://doi.org/10.1080/21670811.2025.2559370
- Gajardo, Mellado (2025). Pistas para restablecer la confianza en el periodismo: Perspectiva de audiencias y profesionales en Chile. Estudios sobre el Mensaje Periodístico. https://doi.org/10.5209/emp.97549
- Gajardo, Mellado (2025). “Journalists are just employees”: Examining journalistic autonomy from an audience perspective. Journalism Studies. https://doi.org/10.1080/1461670X.2024.2416062

- Gajardo, Costera Meijer (2023). How loyalty works: Why do people continue their relationship with journalism?. Journalism Studies. https://doi.org/10.1080/1461670X.2023.2178246
- Gajardo, Costera Meijer (2023). How to tackle the conceptual inconsistency of audience engagement? The introduction of the Dynamic Model of Audience Engagement. Journalism. https://doi.org/10.1177/14648849221080356
- Gajardo, Costera Meijer, Domingo (2023). From abstract news users to living citizens: Assessing audience engagement through a professional lens. Journalism Practice. https://doi.org/10.1080/17512786.2021.1925949
